error.invalid_country: MeteoAlarm has no warnings feed for this country.

data_description.country: The country whose MeteoAlarm feed to use.
data_description.language: Language code for the warning texts, such as `en` or `de`. Warnings not available in this language are shown in the first language the feed has.
data_description.province: The region's name as MeteoAlarm shows it, or its EMMA_ID code. You can find both on meteoalarm.org.

user.description: Get weather warnings for a region from MeteoAlarm.

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.description:
Configuring MeteoAlarm using YAML is being removed, but your configuration for {province} ({country}) could not be imported because MeteoAlarm could not be reached.

Check your internet connection and restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the `meteoalarm` binary sensor from your configuration.yaml and add the integration in the UI.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.title: The MeteoAlarm YAML configuration import failed

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_cou.description:
Configuring MeteoAlarm using YAML is being removed, but your configuration for {province} ({country}) could not be imported because MeteoAlarm has no feed for that country.

Correct the country in your YAML configuration and restart Home Assistant, or remove the `meteoalarm` binary sensor from your configuration.yaml and add the integration in the UI.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_cou.title: [%key:component::meteoalarm::issues::deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_connect::title%]
